label: Admissible essence property
resolution: `WorldInvariantProperty` admits every property with a fixed extension for each individual across worlds. `BooleanGeneratedProperty atom` admits exactly the Boolean readouts of a selected primitive atom and may include properties that vary between worlds while excluding many invariant or naming properties. The latter is not a set-theoretic superset of the former, and an unconstrained atom can encode individual or world names. Both restrict the candidate essence and comparison-property quantifiers of the stipulated `FilteredNecessaryExistence`; neither is Scott's original unrestricted AFP property quantification or a metaphysically established property domain.
